analysis.title: Broadening Growth Supports a Stronger Outlook (eBay)
key_insights: eBay 3Q26 GMV, revenue, Adj. Operating Income and Adj. EPS beat consensus by 4%, 3%, 6% and 7% respectively. The 4Q outlook is also ahead of consensus on these metrics.
Strategic priorities (Focus Categories, C2C, Recommerce) are 72% of GMV excluding Depop and grew about 20% y/y FXN in 3Q, each above 20%.
US active buyers grew 6% y/y organically and 13% pro forma including Depop. DB treats the organic figure as the better read of marketplace health.

Management did not guide FY27 but expects 'healthy' consolidated y/y growth in GMV (FXN), revenue (FXN), non-GAAP operating income and non-GAAP EPS. DB says this eases investor concerns about GMV growth.
DB reiterates Buy and raises its price target to $135 from $124, based on about 21x FY27 adjusted EPS (19x previously). DB calls this a discount to the S&P 500 multiple and conservative.
GMV growth should outpace revenue growth in 4Q because of Depop's lower take rate, net revenue recognition for UK managed shipping, and category and ASP mix shifts.

3Q Adj. Operating Income rose 11.1% to $843mn while margin fell about 62bps y/y to 26.3%, still about 86bps above expectations. DB forecasts roughly flat Adj. operating margin in 4Q and FY27 with operating income growth.
DB raises FY26 adjusted EPS to $6.27 from $5.98 and revenue to $12,656mn from $12,240mn.

market_movers.rationale: Price target raised to $135 from $124 on a higher 21x FY27 adjusted EPS multiple, reflecting a stronger and more durable growth outlook after the 3Q26 beat.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 reported 10/28-29: total GMV $23,166mn vs Street $22,398mn (+3.4%) and DBe $22,316mn (+3.8%), up 15.2% y/y. Total revenue $3,206mn vs Street $3,134mn (+2.3%), up 13.7% y/y.
3Q26 Adj. EPS reported $1.51 vs Street $1.42 (+6.7%) and DBe $1.44, above the company guide of $1.36-1.42. GAAP diluted EPS reported $1.10 vs Street $1.04, guide $0.94-0.99.
3Q26 Adj. Operating Income reported $843mn vs Street $793mn (+6.3%), guide $770-800mn. Adj. OI margin 26.3% vs Street 25.4%. GAAP operating income $616mn vs Street $595mn.

4Q26 guidance: GMV $23.7-24.1bn, revenue $3.19-3.24bn, Adj. operating income $820-850mn, Adj. EPS $1.48-1.53, GAAP EPS $0.82-0.87. GMV midpoint is about 3% above consensus and revenue about 0.4% above.
DB 4Q26 estimates (forecast): GMV $23,890mn, revenue $3,227mn, Adj. EPS $1.49 vs Street $1.50. DB FY26E Adj. EPS $6.27 vs Street $6.21. DB FY27E Adj. EPS $6.56 (up from $6.45) vs Street $6.84.
Payments fees revenue $764mn in 3Q26, up 17.0% y/y. Advertising revenue $607mn, up 15.6% y/y. Transaction fees $1,835mn, up 11.8% y/y.
US GMV $12,545mn in 3Q26, up 27.1% y/y. International GMV $10,621mn, up 3.8% y/y.
risk_factors: Worsening macro environment could pressure DB estimates.
Reinvestment and category mix constrain near-term margin expansion.

tension_points.bull_case: Strategic priorities grew about 20% y/y and US organic buyers grew 6%, supporting a durable growth algorithm and 'healthy' FY27 growth commentary.
tension_points.bear_case: Reinvestment and category mix constrain margin expansion. Adj. OI margin fell about 62bps y/y in 3Q and DB models roughly flat margins in 4Q and FY27.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Lower-than-expected buyer growth or a worsening macro environment that pressures estimates.

theme_stances.key_argument: Differentiated inventory attracts buyers while category-specific experiences and lower seller friction convert demand into transactions.
theme_stances.evidence: differentiated supply, expanding demand, and broader marketplace relevance
